entries.reason: Economy transfer hooks form a global resource mutation system and declare synchronous event ownership.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.entity_scope: Registered economy accounts and transfer hooks owned by the economy module.
entries.view: Process-local registry of accounts and hooks; no raw account pointers are retained by callers.
entries.read_set: Account balances, transfer requests and registered hook metadata.
entries.write_set: Account balances and emitted transfer event records after validation.
entries.structural_changes: No entity creation/destruction; registration replaces process-local hook tables synchronously.
entries.events: Transfer events are delivered after balance mutation through registered synchronous hooks.
entries.services: Injected hook functions and caller-supplied transfer requests; hooks are not invoked while mutating registry structure.
